title: Mom Faces Arrest at School After Daughter’s Beatings Come to Light
description:
On September 11th, 2024. Deputies were called a school regarding injuries found on a child, according to statements, the child had a busted blood vessel near her eye and she had gotten hit multiple times in the face after she got the answers to her homework wrong.  The deputies conducted multiple interviews on her 3 kids and their statements all matched.
